criteria: Multipart and raw manifest upload endpoints accept requirements.txt and package.json
Dependencies safely parsed without code execution
PyPI and npm registry clients query available versions with caching
Outdated packages classified into Up-to-Date, Upgrade Available, or Preserved
Malformed manifests fail gracefully with diagnostic error responses
data.title: Manifest ingestion and dependency analysis

criteria: Provider-independent AI interface defined
Ollama service implemented with dynamic model discovery
Structured recommendation output generated
AI versions validated against registry ground truth
Deterministic fallback operates when Ollama is offline
data.title: Upgrade recommendations and AI provider

criteria: Upgrade plan endpoint accepts selected candidate packages
Manifest modifier applies changes preserving formatting and comments
Unified diff generator produces standard diffs
Human approval gate enforced prior to workspace mutation
data.title: Upgrade planning and patch generation

criteria: Docker runner executes test commands inside container with --network none and resource caps
Execution logs and exit codes captured
Truthful reporting of PASS, FAIL, and NOT_RUNNABLE when Docker is unavailable
Fail-closed container cleanup on success, failure, timeout, and interruption
data.title: Sandboxed validation

criteria: Export service bundles changes into downloadable .patch files and JSON execution summaries
Complete execution logs and SHA-256 checksums generated
Secret sanitization scanner verifies zero credential leakage
Download endpoints serve patch files and summaries

Implements responsive loading, empty, and actionable error states
